ctx.x: I'm going to play." I said, "C'mon with me."
So I had -- Red Mack was the trumpet. I had Charlie Mingus.

items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I was with Barney Bigard before I went to him

ctx.x: Well, see, I was with Barney Bigard before I went to him, and (inaudible). So I got the footwork with Barney Bigard. He's the one who got Kid Orey out of the post office.
